identificationModule.briefTitle: A Survey to Evaluate Diabetes Management, Control, Chronic Complications, Psychosocial Aspects of Diabetic Subjects in Indonesia
identificationModule.officialTitle: DiabCare Asia 2008. A Cross-sectional Survey to Evaluate Diabetes Management, Control, Complications, Psychosocial Aspects of Diabetic Patients in Asia and to Evaluate Perceptions and Practices of Physicians and Patients About Diabetes Management in Asia. DiabCare Asia 2008 - Indonesia

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is conducted in Asia. The aim of this observational study is to evaluate current status of diabetes management, control, complications in diabetic subjects in Asia. Further perceptions and practices of physicians and subjects about diabetes management in Asia will be evaluated.

keywords: DiabCare Asia 2008, Cross-sectional survey, Glycemic control, Psychosocial well-being, Diabetic complications, Quality of life.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Mean age of onset of either type 1 or type 2 diabetes mellitus
Mean duration of treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus.
Percentage of patients on either insulin therapy or OAD (oral anti-diabetic drug) therapy.
Mean duration of diabetes in type 1 and type 2 diabetes patients respectively.
Mean FPG (fasting plasma glucose),PPG (post prandial glucose) and HbA1c of diabetic patients.
Percentage of diabetic patients with HbA1c target below or equal to 7.0%.
Percentage of diabetic patients with HbA1c target below or equal to 6.5%.
Percentage of diabetic patients having dyslipidemia and hypertension
Percentage of diabetic patients having cardiovascular complications
Percentage of diabetic patients having peripheral vascular disease
Percentage of diabetic patients having diabetic nephropathy
Percentage of diabetic patients having diabetic eye complications

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Patients' perception will be analysed through Patient questionnaire measuring:Psychological well-being, Quality of life and Patients' compliant to treatment
Physician questionnaire measuring awareness about:HbA1c test and its goal, Anti-diabetic treatment and Barriers towards optimum diabetes control
Duration of diabetes associated with highest number of diabetic complications
Minimum duration of diabetes associated with 10% incidence of diabetic complications (CVD, nephropathy and retinopathy)

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diabetic patients registered in the particular centre for more than 12 months.
* Patients should have visited the centre at least once in the last 3-6 months before the initial study visit.
* Patients willing to sign informed consent form.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Repetition of any patient as patients should not be included twice for any reason.
* Unwilling to participate or unable to comply with protocol requirements.
eligibilityModule.studyPopulation: Patients with diabetes mellitus (both type 1 and type 2) being treated at general hospitals, diabetes clinics and referral clinics will be selected according to inclusion and exclusion criteria. Patients will be selected randomly from clinic record/list to avoid any bias.
